analysis.description: This paper proposes Bijective-Contrastive Estimation (BCE), a classification-based learning criterion for energy-based models (EBMs). The approach uses bijections to generate contrasting distributions and solves classification problems between these distributions and the original data distribution using a classifier parameterized by an energy model. The paper demonstrates the method's effectiveness on 2D synthetic datasets while discussing its challenges in high-dimensional scenarios.

name.quote: By jointly solving a sufficiently large collection of classification problems with shared parameters, the EBM is guaranteed to recover the data distribution’s density up to a normalizing constant.
